component.name: @sdkwork/iam-pc-console-cloud-account
component.displayName: SDKWork IAM PC Console Cloud Account

integration.dependencyPolicy: Consumes @sdkwork/iam-service and the shared iam-contracts vocabulary; sibling console packages are not imported, so the module registry stays the only composition seam.
integration.sdkPolicy: No SDK client is constructed here. All account-center calls flow through the injected SdkworkIamService, which reaches the account center's dual-token route set at /backend/v3/api/iam/provider_accounts through the host-supplied backend client; the console tier therefore declares the app SDK family only and never depends on a backend SDK package.
